verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents team-scoped API keys and lets team admins revoke other members' keys, which implies an admin role. It also documents adding and removing users to control machine access. Missing for 10: a documented role model beyond the implied team admin, per-key permission scoping finer than team level, team member invitation and role assignment workflows, spend controls such as budgets or limits, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can manage team members with roles and scoped API keys so credentials and spend stay controlled

citations.quote: If you are a team admin, you can also revoke keys that belong to other team members.
Add or remove users to control who can access and administer your machine.
